Basis: Current BX has 2,591 Momentum time-exit contracts but little meaningful retracement; Value closes 1,234 contracts through stops versus 646 ordinary exits; Reserve has 74,884 same-decision replacements in 74,946 total and only 543 filled contracts.

Variants.time-exit-size: Concentrate existing time-exit flow into full normal child sizes, retaining the same decision cadence, hold deadlines, slippage, funding and risk exits.
Variants.value-exit-gate: Allow original Value signal to reduce inventory without a new-entry valuation-edge hurdle. New risk still needs the old edge. No profit target or new memory horizon.
Variants.reserve-cost-quote: Nearest closing-side Reserve quote retains a cost-based limit at entry plus existing depth offset, instead of always following prints. Passive guard and original size remain.

Selection: Same fixed development gates. No independent-validation cases inspected. These are isolated probes; no effect attributed to a combination.
